title: Stats widget isn't updated when paginating search results
body:
**Describe the bug 🐛**
When I paginate the search results, the stats widget isn't updated.

**To Reproduce 🔍**

1. Go to https://codepen.io/stianmartinsen/pen/EpOpKJ
2. Switch page in the pagination widget
3. See that the current page in the stats is not updated
